name: Alpic
description: Manage your projects, debug deployments, and check analytics for any MCP server  and MCP App you host with Alpic.ai

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alpic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alpic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.alpic.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alpic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alpic provides these MCP tools: deployment-logs, get-analytics, list-projects, list-teams, and show-analytics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alpic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alpic in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Alpic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alpic is developed by Alpic. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
